profile.summary: A private Jesuit university in San Francisco, California. It offers undergraduate and graduate degrees. The university also hosts the Upward Bound Math & Science program, a federally funded college-preparation program that offers advising, tutoring, mentoring and a summer program to eligible public high school students.

sources.title: University Of San Francisco - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
Program Information - Upward Bound at USF

review.notes: The organization is the University of San Francisco (EIN 94-1156628, 2130 Fulton St, 415-422-5555 all confirmed), matching the agenda. However, the summary calls the Upward Bound program 'federally funded', and the cited program page gives no funding information. That page also lists only San Francisco high schools as served, so the summary's program description is not clearly tied to the OUSD contract. Identity, legalName, ein, website, phone, address and headquarters are fine; the summary should be rewritten without the funding claim.
